user.title: Set up Mondial Relay
user.description: Follow parcels sent to you by their tracking code, or sign in to a Mondial Relay account.

account.title: Set up a Mondial Relay account
account.description: Choose the country your Mondial Relay account is registered in. It decides which sign-in page you get, and the phone number it accepts.

tracking.title: Track parcels by tracking code
tracking.description:
No account needed — just the postcode the parcels are addressed to. Every parcel you add to this hub is looked up with it. Add another hub for a different postcode.

Parcels you send are not followed here; they come from an account hub.

data_description.postal_code: The postcode the parcel is addressed to, written as on the label.

sign_in.title: Sign in to Mondial Relay
sign_in.description:
**Do this first:** sign in once at {website_url} with the account you want to use, and make sure your phone number is confirmed there. Mondial Relay does not release an account's parcels until it has signed in on their own site or app at least once, and Home Assistant cannot do that step for you.

Then open this address in a browser and sign in with your Mondial Relay (InPost Group) account:

{authorize_url}

The page will not finish loading afterwards — that is expected. Copy the full address from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Mondial Relay sign-in expired

error.invalid_auth: Mondial Relay rejected that sign-in. The address a sign-in produces can only be used once and expires quickly — open the link above again and paste the new address.
error.phone_not_confirmed: Mondial Relay would not hand over this account's parcel list, and its phone number has not been confirmed — which is the likeliest reason. Open the Mondial Relay app or website, sign in with this account and confirm your phone number, then try again.
error.parcels_unavailable: The account is valid, but Mondial Relay would not release its parcel list. The usual cause is an account that has never signed in on Mondial Relay's own site or app — do that once, then repeat the sign-in here. If it keeps happening, please report it with the warning logged under custom_components.mondial_relay.
error.account_rejected: Signing in worked, but Mondial Relay's account service refused the session it had just issued. The usual cause is an account that has never signed in on Mondial Relay's own site or app — do that once, then repeat the sign-in here. If it keeps happening, please report it with the warning logged under custom_components.mondial_relay.
error.invalid_redirect: That does not look like the address the sign-in page redirected you to. Make sure you copied the whole thing after signing in.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mondial Relay. Please try again.
error.invalid_postcode: Enter the postcode the parcels are addressed to.

abort.already_configured: That Mondial Relay account or postcode is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in was for a different Mondial Relay account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.
